source: Recorded Gemini Live (gemini-3.8-live) narration sessions, Nov 2026. "tuning" (9), "holdout-1" (8), "holdout-2" (8), "holdout-3" (10) and "in-app" (8, captured from the browser during the Playwright E2E with the real app prompt) shaped the streaming rule over successive rounds; each round was validated on sessions recorded after it. "continuation" (8) and "continuation-holdout" (10, never used for tuning) are later stops of a visit: no greeting, a long opening sentence.
reference: Sentence starts from a monotonic alignment of transcript punctuation to audio pauses (scratch/narration/eval_sync.mts); null = no acoustic pause before the sentence.
stream: Per chunk: audio = [tSec, 0, durSec, settledSec, onsetsKnown]; text = [tSec, 1, text]. tSec is relative to the first audio chunk.
